name: Void Ogre Dragon Zero
desc:
1 DARK Tuner + 2+ non-Tuners
Cannot be destroyed by card effects while you have a DARK monster with 0 ATK or DEF in your GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Void Ogre Dragon Zero" once per turn. If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can send 1 "Infernity" monster from your Deck to the GY. When your opponent activates a card or effect and you have no cards in your hand (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card, and if you do that, this card gains 500 ATK.
